notes: HER 0.1.0-hashi.12 makes effort a capability ceiling selected by an adaptive task profile. Planning determines deliverables, material claims, verification, testing, review scope, and stop conditions; trivial work completes directly at every planned effort. XHIGH, MAX, and MAX+ can use an advisory independent reviewer with separate read-only workspace and Git tools plus an addressable raw-evidence store. MAX+ alone can rerun exact plan-declared test commands in a disposable network-isolated snapshot. Reviewer feedback cannot suppress the primary agent's final answer, and no private token or wall-clock budget exists.
